findings.issue: Lemma 2142, Niphal imperfect 3rd feminine singular, is rendered as the attributive adjective macho, dropping stem, person, and imperfect and closing the form as male.
Lemma 7716, common-gender singular (one of a flock: sheep or goat), is narrowed to cordero (young sheep).

notes: כל, פטר רחם, לי, מקנך, and שור match Todo, abridor de matriz, a mí, tu ganado, and buey.
